title: The physics wall facing orbital AI data centers
description: Basing entire business plans on back-of-the-envelope calculations might not seem like the best idea. However, according to a new paper by Dr. Slava Turyshev of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, available as a preprint on arXiv, that is precisely what the companies touting orbital AI data centers are doing.

title: 'I wanted to dance in a film, but now people will call it AI': Mammootty
description: In a lighthearted yet poignant observation, Mammootty considered the impact of artificial intelligence on online dance videos, admitting his hesitation to dance on-screen for fear of being mistaken for an AI avatar. He voiced concerns about the broader implications of AI technology, emphasizing its misuse by those in power and its potential to affect society in troubling ways.

title: AI Swaps Actors' Clothes After Filming Wraps, Rewriting Ad Rules
